questions.text:
Read the resource booklet about wildfires in Canada. Integrate geographic concepts and supporting evidence from any of the resources into your answers.

Using evidence from the resources, describe the pattern (spatial or temporal) of Canadian wildfires.
questions.markingGuide: Achievement: Partially describes the spatial or temporal pattern of Canadian wildfires. Describes a pattern with limited evidence. Merit: Describes the spatial or temporal pattern in detail with supporting evidence from resources. Describes two different patterns or one in detail with specific data. Excellence: Description is detailed with comprehensive evidence integrated throughout.

questions.text: Wildfires are an environmental disaster with significant environmental, economic, and social costs. Evaluate the consequences of wildfires for people and the environment.
questions.expectedAnswer: Evaluates environmental consequences (habitat destruction, air quality, carbon release),...
questions.markingGuide: Achievement: Includes some evidence from resources that demonstrates use of geographic skills and conventions. Responses may lack specific concepts or geographic terminology. Merit: Includes evidence from resources that includes detailed geographic skills and conventions. Response shows some geographic concepts and geographic skills and conventions. Excellence: Includes detailed evidence from resources. Comprehensively evaluates the consequences for people and the environment with insight, using geographic terminology. Evidence is fully integrated.
